Meanwhile, HIDDEN_DIM, WEIGHT_DECAY, and BATCH_SIZE have been changed only in combination with poor LR choices, so their individual effects are unknown. The search is too broad in randomness but too narrow in exploration of other parameters under favorable LR conditions.
analysis.guidance: Now that LR=0.006 gave best result, fix LR at that best value and systematically explore WEIGHT_DECAY and BATCH_SIZE one at a time. Do not change HIDDEN_DIM. First vary WEIGHT_DECAY (e.g., log scale around 0.0001), then BATCH_SIZE (powers of 2 from 16 to 128). Keep all other parameters at best-known settings (LR=0.006, HIDDEN_DIM=256, BATCH_SIZE=64 initially). This isolates the effect of each remaining parameter given the optimal LR.
analysis.reasoning: LR has been over-explored with no further gain, so it should be temporarily fixed at its best value to measure the impact of other parameters. HIDDEN_DIM changes have been rare and tied to poor LR choices, so freezing it avoids confounding. WEIGHT_DECAY and BATCH_SIZE are under-explored under good LR conditions; focusing on them sequentially will reveal their true contribution. The strategy shifts from broad exploration to targeted exploitation around the best-known point.
